name: feature-blackbox
sentence: Pays 80 test USDC when check `unit` passes on a pull request that also passes the issue's black-box acceptance suite; refund after 14 days
where: an issue that has .knos/acceptance/<issue>/ on the default branch

assumes.checks: each named check is a GitHub Actions job (GitHub App 15368) that ran on the default branch's latest commit
assumes.accept: a sample hash: yours is the hash of your own acceptance bundle
